**SPECIAL DELIVERY** — Probably the only proof that this issue was supposed to come out at Christmas. I converted it from the SPECCY CD ROM and equipped it with a uniloader to make it runnable on any system (+D users probably would have settled for a snapshot, but that is not my style, unlike other magazines).
